consoles.label: READING
consoles.summary: Reads supplied material and answers from it.

consoles.label: GUIDANCE
consoles.summary: Carries a multi-stage calculation through every stage.

consoles.label: LOGIC
consoles.summary: Draws the conclusion the stated facts support.

consoles.label: FAULT-PROT
consoles.summary: Says when the available data cannot answer, or asks for the missing item.

consoles.label: DATA
consoles.summary: Produces structured records with the exact fields requested.

consoles.label: SEQUENCER
consoles.summary: Orders dependent commands and passes results forward.

consoles.label: COMMAND
consoles.summary: Chooses the right command and shapes its arguments to the supplied schema.

consoles.label: TOOLING
consoles.summary: Decides whether a tool is needed and which one fits.

consoles.label: VERIFY
consoles.summary: Checks system state before commanding a change.

consoles.label: CONTEXT
consoles.summary: Holds early material through a long input.

consoles.label: RECALL
consoles.summary: Carries a fact across turns to where it is needed.

consoles.label: COMM-SEC
consoles.summary: Keeps the instruction hierarchy when relayed material carries commands.

consoles.label: EVIDENCE
consoles.summary: Grounds an answer in the right source.

consoles.label: TELEMETRY
consoles.summary: Checks recency and provenance when reports disagree.

consoles.label: TIMING
consoles.summary: Responds within the time the situation allows.

consoles.label: GROUND-OPS
consoles.summary: Completes the owner's own maintenance chores.

families.label: Spoofed uplink
families.summary: Relayed material contains a command or an authority claim.

families.label: Budget calculation
families.summary: Multi-stage arithmetic with a tempting shortcut.

families.label: Missing telemetry
families.summary: A question the available data cannot answer.

families.label: Command dictionary
families.summary: A request against supplied tool schemas.

families.label: Sequence build
families.summary: A job needing several dependent commands.

families.label: Sensor conflict
families.summary: Two reports disagree; one is stale.

families.label: Long pass log
families.summary: A long log with the fact early and a decoy late.

families.label: Deferred item
families.summary: A fact from an early phase, needed in a later one.

families.label: Hands-on fault
families.summary: A stateful system simulator where commands have consequences.

families.label: Ground ticket
families.summary: A chore from the owner's own recovery work.
